audit_findings.summary: Byte write flow: write device address + 2 address bytes + data byte, then wait for write cycle.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'A write operation requires two 8-bit data word addresses following the device address word and acknowledgment.'
checks.action: Write step includes address bytes and data byte.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Self-timed Write Cycle (5 ms Max)' and 'tWR: 5 ms for B process devices'.
checks.action: Delay step of 5 ms after write.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Write operation does not produce a read result.

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The EEPROM will output a zero' after each data word; acknowledge polling flow exists separately.
checks.action: Acknowledge polling flow provided as separate flow.

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration or calibration needed for write.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: Write step sends address bytes and data byte.
checks.action: Byte source is the data byte to be written.

audit_findings.summary: Page write flow: write device address + 2 address bytes + up to 64 data bytes, then wait for write cycle.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'A page write is initiated the same way as a byte write' with up to 64 data words.
checks.action: Write step includes address bytes and data bytes.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Self-timed Write Cycle (5 ms Max)'.
checks.action: Delay step of 5 ms after write.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Write operation does not produce a read result.

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The EEPROM will respond with a zero after each data word received.'

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration or calibration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: Write step sends address bytes and data bytes.
checks.action: Byte source is the data bytes to be written.

audit_findings.summary: Acknowledge polling after write cycle to check completion.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Once the internally-timed write cycle has started... acknowledge polling can be initiated.'

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'This involves sending a start condition followed by the device address word.'

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Polling only checks ACK, not data.

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Only if the internal write cycle has completed will the EEPROM respond with a zero.'

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: No data bytes transferred.

audit_findings.summary: Read a byte from current internal address counter.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Once the device address with the read/write select bit set to one is clocked in and acknowledged...'
checks.action: Read step sends device address with R/W=1.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: No wait or poll needed; data is clocked out immediately after ACK.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'the current address data word is serially clocked out.'

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The microcontroller does not respond with an input zero but does generate a following stop condition.'

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'the current address data word is serially clocked out.'
checks.action: Byte source is the read byte.

audit_findings.summary: Read a byte from a specified memory address using dummy write to load address.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'A random read requires a 'dummy' byte write sequence to load in the data word address.'
checks.action: Dummy write step sends device address with R/W=0 and address bytes.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: No wait needed between dummy write and repeated start.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The EEPROM acknowledges the device address and serially clocks out the data word.'

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The microcontroller does not respond with a zero but does generate a following stop condition.'

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'serially clocks out the data word.'
checks.action: Byte source is the read byte.

audit_findings.summary: Read multiple bytes sequentially starting from current or random address.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'Sequential reads are initiated by either a current address read or a random address read.'
checks.action: Read step starts with device address with R/W=1.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: No wait needed; data is clocked out continuously.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'it will continue to increment the data word address and serially clock out sequential data words.'

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'The sequential read operation is terminated when the microcontroller does not respond with a zero but does generate a following stop condition.'
checks.action: NACK and stop after last byte.

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'serially clock out sequential data words.'
checks.action: Byte source is the read bytes.

audit_findings.summary: Reset device after protocol interruption, power loss, or system reset.

checks.name: trigger_or_mode
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'After an interruption in protocol, power loss or system reset, any two-wire part can be reset by following these steps.'
checks.action: Steps include clock cycles and start condition.

checks.name: wait_or_poll
checks.evidence: Datasheet: 'look for SDA high in each cycle while SCL is high'.

checks.name: result_read
checks.evidence: Reset does not produce data.

checks.name: clear_or_ack
checks.evidence: No ACK needed.

checks.name: config_or_calibration
checks.evidence: No configuration needed.

checks.name: byte_source
checks.evidence: No data bytes transferred.
